mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, username, display_name, password_hash, status, version, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, tenant_id, username, display_name, password_hash, status, version, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, #{version}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO role (id, tenant_id, code, name, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO role_permission (tenant_id, role_id, permission_code) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{roleId}, #{permissionCode}) ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_code) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO user_role (tenant_id, user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{roleId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_code FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY rp.permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_hotel_scope (tenant_id, user_id, hotel_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{hotelId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, hotel_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT hotel_id FROM user_hotel_scope WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY hotel_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_session (id, tenant_id, user_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revoke_reason, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{revokeReason}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.tenant_id AS tenant_id, s.user_id AS user_id, u.username AS username, u.display_name AS display_name, s.expires_at AS expires_at FROM user_session s JOIN app_user u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.tenant_id = s.tenant_id JOIN tenant t ON t.id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > now() AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE user_session SET revoked_at = #{at}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
